notes.title: Big update of version 1.5
notes.notes:
Big update of version 1.5 
1) Optimization of the game. There are no downloads next to the doors. 
2) A flashlight is added. 
3) Not all rooms have lighting. 
4) Added more scary moments in the game. 
5) Some game models are changed, beyond recognition. 
6) The work was carried out with subsequent processing. 
7) Some flaws are removed. 
8) Added new monsters. 
And many other positive changes.

notes.title: Released patch version 1.3
notes.notes:
Released patch version 1.3

1) Removed the problem sometimes occurs when loading save games.
2) Modified the locations where there were problems.
3) Now you can't throw away keys from the inventory, the cross.

If you have any problems with the game, they fixed it, now you can play for fun.
We apologize for the bugs, bugs that were not noticed during the test games before release.
